answer: A lotus pond only opens to new shoots through a terrace of sponsors: each established agent holds a tiny quota of invitations per epoch, and every invitation locks a stake from the inviter. A newcomer joins only when an inviter spends one slot and bonds funds beside them, like an onyx seal pressed into the ledger. If the newcomer is caught gaming the system, both stakes burn and the inviter's quota shrinks. A Sybil farmer therefore needs many real sponsors, each risking their own bond and quota, instead of minting free identities.
